 Abortion rights amendment passes in Virginia
 Politics 
 Nov 3, 2026 9:56 PM EST
 2026 ELECTION COVERAGE: Watch Live | Poll Closing Times | All Live Results | Live Updates | Live Fact Check 
 Voters have approved a ballot measure that creates a "fundamental right to reproductive freedom" in the Virginia Constitution.
 The amendment passed Tuesday ensures abortions can occur during the first two trimesters of pregnancy. It allows government regulations during the third trimester while still ensuring that abortions can be carried out to protect the life and health of pregnant women. The amendment also creates a right to contraception and fertility care, among other things.
 Stand with free and independent journalism. Join Press Pass from PBS News 
 The U.S. Supreme Court overturned a nationwide right to abortion in 2022, opening the way for states to create their own policies. Since then, voters in more than one-fifth of the states have passed ballot measures protecting abortion rights.
